740640101.text: I said, either find a way to remove it or figure out who's behind it.

740640102.text: Easy for you to say... I've tried all kinds of cleaners, and none of 'em worked. If it needs something stronger... We have to try Hydro Phantasm Taint-B-Gone.

740640103.text: Hydro Phantasm Taint-B-Gone? Are you trying to burn a hole through the wall!? We'll all be sleeping with the fishes in no time!

740640104.text: Then we'll have to locate the culprit. But we don't have any clues regarding their identity.

740640105.text: What's wrong? Is there anything we can do for you?

740640106.text: Well... See that mark on the wall? Graffiti is prohibited in the Fortress of Meropide...

740640107.text: We've tried everything, but we still can't remove it, so if we could at least locate the culprit...

740640108.text: Wait, hold on, now that I think about it, we aren't completely without leads. I remember Clynes mentioning that the Fontaine Research Institute has a mark that requires a special method to decipher.

740640109.text: Are you trying to say that it's the same type of mark?

740640110.text: I wasn't interested in the slightest back then, so I didn't bother asking for more information. Maybe he could give us an answer if he was here.

740640112.text: Indeed, we cannot rule out that possibility. But if that's the case, hehe... He should know the rules.

740640115.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, you're knowledgeable adventurers with a wealth of experience, so do you have any ideas?

740640116.text: Help us locate the culprit behind the graffiti, or bring Clynes here to have a look. Hmm... Consider it an official commission then — with Coupons as compensation.

740640117.text: Alright. If it's an official commission, then we'll give it a go.

740640118.text: Thank you. In the meantime, I'll try to find other means of removing it.

740640114.text: I have no idea where he is, though... Haven't seen him all day. And are we really going to ask for his help? I lose a little bit of self-respect every time I ask him for something.

subQuests.subQuestName: Examine the gear patterns on the wall

740640201.text: Would capturing a Blubberbeast and making it spit on the mark work?

740640202.text: Are you serious? Have you been under too much stress lately? Are you still mentally sound? Have you been scheduled for too many shifts?

740640203.text: I'm absolutely fine. I just want to see a Blubberbeast spit.

740640204.text: You... need to take a day off.

subQuests.subQuestName: Find the culprit behind the graffiti

740640303.text: Huh? If Clynes is here, then that mark must've been his doing, then.

740640306.text: Huh? What are you two doing here...?

740640307.text: What are you talking about? I'm lost. Why don't you ask someone else?

740640305.text: 'Fess up! You're the one behind the graffiti, right?

740640401.text: I see you've found Clynes. But... Have you found the person responsible for the graffiti? Or at least any clues?

740640405.text: Ugh, and just like that, all the excuses I came up with are useless. I guess I'm just meat on the chopping block now, waiting to see how you'll dispose of me, huh?

740640407.text: To be honest, I'm more concerned about how to remove this mark than any punishment you'll receive.

740640408.text: You're interested in Cipher Letter technology? It will take quite a bit of time to explain, so why don't you sit down and listen?

740640409.text: No, I'm not interested in the specifics. Just tell me how to remove it...

740640410.text: Even that's a long story. After all, special paint and techniques are utilized...

740640411.text: I have other work to attend to, so keep it short. Uh... Please...

740640412.text: #Let's leave them to it. {NICKNAME} and Paimon, here's the compensation you were promised. Thank you for your help.

740640414.text: Clynes, is this the special mark you mentioned before?

740640415.text: Let me see... Hmm... Oh... Doesn't it look a lot like a gear? Where else could such a huge gear come from, except the Fontaine Research Institute?

740640416.text: It's from the Institute... and so are you. I'd say the link between the two is pretty obvious. Just admit it. You're the culprit, aren't you?

740640417.text: You can't say it like that! If, one day, I should be fortunate enough to dine with Galvana at Hotel Debord...

740640418.text: If you're still in dreamland, I can help you wake up. And if you think my punches aren't strong enough, I'm sure Roussimoff would be willing to lend a hand or three.

740640419.text: Calm down, I'm only giving you an example! It's just an example!

740640420.text: Where was I... *ahem* Anyway, if Galvana and I were to go out together, though we're both from the Fortress, that doesn't mean that there is any connection between us.

740640421.text: See? There's no connection whatsoever! There's no link between me and this mark, just like there's no link between me and Galvana.

740640422.text: Fine, you've convinced me. But only about the relationship between you and Sis.

740640423.text: Doesn't that mean he hasn't convinced you at all?

740640424.text: W—Well, we've got nothing else to say about this. It's up to you guys now!

740640425.text: Well, no matter what, I owe you my thanks. And the compensation you were promised...

740640426.text: #Right! {NICKNAME} and Paimon! I almost forgot your compensation! Although it's a pity you couldn't locate the culprit...

740640427.text: But I'm sure Clynes will have a way to remove the mark! I'll leave the rest to him and Galvaryet, then. In the meantime, I have other work to attend to.

740640501.text: As I said, I have other work to attend to...

740640502.text: Everything has its own proper sequence. You must first understand the principles behind...

740640503.text: What a pain. Sis and I are having dinner together today, so I'm leaving when my shift is over... whether or not this mess has been cleaned up.
